_comment: Feature priors for the two FICTIONAL demo installations (INTERFACES section 2). Keyed by installation id. Read by model.scorer.Scorer. priors.ctLaggedPriorEf is the lagged Climate TRACE prior (direct emissions factor, tCO2e per t steel, mean over months m-14..m-3) BORROWED from the referenced real Climate TRACE asset of the same route and capacity class; it is the value that asset had for the demo periods 2026-09 and 2026-10. The climateTraceReference blocks record which real asset supplied the borrowed values; nothing is stated or implied about any real company.

priors.gridSource: Ember yearly electricity data, power-sector CO2 intensity, TUR 2025 (CC BY 4.0); data/fixtures/grid_intensity_ember_annual.csv
priors.ctLaggedPriorSource: Climate TRACE v5.10.0 asset 1567079 direct emissions factor, mean over 2025-07..2026-06 (12 of 12 months; constant 0.08) for period 2026-09; 2025-08..2026-06 (11 months; constant 0.08) for 2026-10

climateTraceReference.role: source of the borrowed lagged prior (priors.ctLaggedPriorEf) and the route / capacity-class context
climateTraceReference.capacityClassNote: Closest-capacity Turkish EAF in Climate TRACE v5.10.0. The demo mill's 300,000 t/yr is inside the training range (smallest EAF in the training set is 200,000 t/yr).

priors.gridSource: Ember yearly electricity data, power-sector CO2 intensity, TUR 2025 (CC BY 4.0); data/fixtures/grid_intensity_ember_annual.csv
priors.ctLaggedPriorSource: Climate TRACE v5.10.0 asset 1567073 direct emissions factor, mean over 2025-07..2026-06 (10 of 12 months present; constant 1.9) for period 2026-09; 2025-08..2026-06 (9 months; constant 1.9) for 2026-10

climateTraceReference.role: source of the borrowed lagged prior (priors.ctLaggedPriorEf) and the route / capacity-class context
climateTraceReference.capacityClassNote: Turkish BF-BOF plant in Climate TRACE v5.10.0 with essentially the same nameplate capacity (3.501 Mt/yr). The fictional installation is not this company and no inference about it is made.
